title: Analyst
description:
Analyst

Reading - UK-Wide Travel

Up to £36,000 + Career Progression + Great Benefits


The Opportunity:

Get Recruited are recruiting on behalf of an established consultancy business who are looking for an Analyst to join their team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their career looking to develop their analytical, commercial and consulting skills, with structured training and a clear progression pathway into a Management Consultant role. Typically Monday to Thursday on client sites with Fridays working remotely.

This would be a good opportunity for an Analyst, Business Analyst, Graduate Analyst, Junior Business Analyst, Consulting Analyst, Junior Consultant, Graduate Analyst t or Trainee Analyst.

The Role:

  • Analyse business processes, operational data and management systems to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Conduct on-site observations, process mapping and performance assessments.
  • Support the delivery of business transformation and operational improvement projects.
  • Work closely with client managers and operational teams to implement new processes and ways of working.
  • Build strong client relationships and engage with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Monitor project performance and contribute to delivering measurable, sustainable results.
  • Participate in structured training and development to build your consulting expertise.

The Person

  • Previous exposure to a business environment through employment, internships, placements or work experience.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an interest in business improvement.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage with people at all levels.
  • Proactive, adaptable and eager to learn, with a genuine desire to develop a career in consulting.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable travelling regularly to client sites across the UK.
  • Ideally holds a full UK driving licence and has access to a car.
  • Degree in Science, Mathematics, Economics would be desirable.

The Benefits:

  • Performance-related bonus.
  • £4,836 annual car allowance (subject to eligibility)
  • Private medical insurance.
  • 5% employer pension contribution.
  • Life assurance.
  • 25 days' annual leave, increasing to 30 days with service.
  • Employee benefits and discounts platform.
  • Structured training, mentoring and clear career progression.
  • Opportunity to work towards a Management Consultant role.
